Everything checks out. The fix is complete — here's a summary of what was wrong and how I repaired it.

## Diagnosis

`reproduce.py` renders a LAMMPS input from `source/dpgen/generator/run.py` and verifies the generated `pair_style`/`dump` lines carry every model-control term the settings require (mirroring the reference generator `make_lammps_input` in `lammps.py`). The pre-fix status was `pre_fix_expected_failure` with missing `atomic`, `relative 1.5`, `relative_v 2.0`. Three defects in `run.py` caused it:

1. **`build_template_options` dropped `workflow_options`** entirely, so the cluster/relative-deviation settings never reached the renderer; it also never derived the electron-temperature style from `ele_temp_f`/`ele_temp_a` (the reference supports `fparam ${ELE_TEMP}` and `aparam ${ELE_TEMP}`).
2. **`revise_lmp_input_model` never emitted the model-deviation keywords** (`atomic`, `relative <eps>`, `relative_v <eps>`) — only `out_freq`/`out_file` plus an optional `fparam`.
3. **`render_external_template_input` never applied `revise_lmp_input_dump`**, so `model_devi_merge_traj` was silently ignored, and the merge case had no restart `dump_modify … append yes` line.

## Fix (only `source/dpgen/generator/run.py` touched)

- `build_template_options` now derives `use_ele_temp` from `ele_temp_f`→1 / `ele_temp_a`→2 (rejecting both set simultaneously, and `ele_temp` with `deepmd_version < 1`, matching the reference's error contract), and forwards `workflow_options` into the template options.
- `revise_lmp_input_model` appends the settings-driven keyword tokens `atomic`, `relative <epsilon>`, `relative_v <epsilon_v>`, and `fparam`/`aparam ${ELE_TEMP}` in the same order as the reference generator; the legacy `deepmd < 1` line format is preserved.
- `render_external_template_input` now also runs `revise_lmp_input_dump` with `model_devi_merge_traj` (resolved from template options or workflow options), so the merged-trajectory path (`all.lammpstrj` + restart `dump_modify append`) and per-task path (`traj/*.lammpstrj`, no `dump_modify`) are produced consistently; a pre-existing `dump_modify` line is neither duplicated nor left behind.

All revisions remain keyword-anchored (`find_only_one_key`) and fully settings-driven — no fixture, graph list, template line, or output text was hard-coded.

## Verification

- `python reproduce.py` → **`workflow_completed`**: `pair_style … out_freq 10 out_file model_devi.out atomic relative 1.5 relative_v 2.0`, no missing pair/dump tokens.
- A separate matrix harness (outside the repo) covering **all combinations** — 4 workflow flags × 3 ele_temp variants × 2 deepmd versions, plus legacy `<1` format, error contracts, parity of emitted keywords against the reference `make_lammps_input`, absent/`None` `workflow_options`, pre-existing `dump_modify` lines, and render idempotency — passed **103/103 checks**.
